responsibility: Public runtime header exposing LoongArch base instruction intrinsics to user code. It wraps target builtins and a few inline asm sequences in C/C++-usable interfaces for timer reads, FCSR moves, cache operations, CPU configuration, CRC instructions, CSR/IOCSR access, barriers, syscall/break, and related privileged or architectural operations, with ABI-conditional forms for 64-bit LoongArch.
